name: smallpowers
description: Explicit-only Codex workflows for feature development, repository simplification, and safe Git-worktree workspace operations.

interface.longDescription: Smallpowers instructions stay unloaded until explicitly invoked, then progressively load detailed feature stages, feedback routing, complexity audits, scoped cleanup, or bounded Git-worktree workspace operations.
capabilities: Simple worktree workspace setup and restore
Task-scoped worktree binding and merged-branch cleanup
defaultPrompt: Use $smallpowers to design and implement this feature.
Use $smallpowers-audit to find removable repository complexity.
Use $work-in refactor/worktree to create or reuse that branch worktree and bind this task to it.
